text: In this unit Alex starts work in Berlin and, with Max's help in the office kitchen, learns to describe a normal working day. You will tell the time, say when things begin and end, describe a normal day and talk about your work or your studies. You will also talk about your plans. The scenes are set in places you may know: an office, a lecture hall, a lab and a tea kitchen.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
